title: Fiery Mind Awakening
description: A surreal composition featuring a stern bald child with a swirling blue flame erupting from their head, positioned beside a green-skinned woman in profile whose hair transforms into a dramatic fiery vortex of red, orange, and blue. In the foreground are vibrant purple and red flowers, while a cartoon teddy bear icon appears on the right against a background of diagonal blue and yellow stripes and black dots.
